card.name: Closing spots before a bracket or sentence end
card.fires_on: The last word or number just before a closing parenthesis, such as a cross-reference number like (4) or the word valid in a broken-link message. Also variable names inside logic formulas.

modes.label: Cross-reference numbers
modes.description: A section number inside a see-Contraindications reference, right before the closing bracket.

modes.label: Broken link message
modes.description: The word valid at the end of the phrase Error! Hyperlink reference not valid.
modes.example: Error! Hyperlink reference not<< valid>>. , Error! Hyperlink reference not

modes.label: Logic formula variables
modes.description: A variable name like REGION or OBJ at the end of a bracketed logic expression.

card.writes: It favors closing punctuation such as quote-paren-period or paren-semicolon endings, as in code.
card.plain: It marks the last word before a closing bracket, like a section number or the end of a link error message.
